title: Read a hosted workspace snapshot
responsibility: Resolve the selected branch and commit and build or reuse a validated read-only catalog snapshot.

inputs.name: hubSnapshot.input
inputs.type: { actor: Actor; source: SourceHistoryAdapter; cache: CollaborationCache; project: ProjectSummary; }
inputs.description: Authenticated actor, source adapter, cache and already-authorized project summary with role.

inputs.name: hubSnapshot.query
inputs.type: { branch: string | null; commit: string | null }
inputs.description: Optional branch and commit. Missing branch prefers main, otherwise the first listed branch; missing commit selects that branch tip.

outputs.name: hubSnapshot
outputs.description: Snapshot with project, revision, branch/commit lists, listed catalog entities and cache identity. Source editing, agents, planning and approval are off; comments are enabled unless role is viewer.
